target.title: fix: recover interrupted command dispatches
target.body:
## What changed

This keeps the useful pre-dispatch claim from #380, but makes the claim recoverable instead of terminal.

- Every review, assist, and repair dispatch now carries a deterministic receipt key.
- A retry first looks for the exact Actions run created after the durable claim. Active runs keep the claim waiting, successful runs finalize recovery, and cancelled, failed, skipped, or timed-out runs become retryable after the visibility window.
- The receiving queue and workflows deterministically give the oldest active or successful same-key run ownership, while later duplicates and failed older runs cannot suppress all execution.
- The review path no longer falls back to an untraceable second dispatch mechanism.
- Active repair detection recognizes keyed run names, including issue-implementation titles, and the waiting claim keeps its original timestamp.
- Synthetic label-sweep commands recover prior claims by stable idempotency key even though their per-run timestamps change.
- Synthetic label-sweep receipts are scoped to one durable claim attempt: an interrupted retry reuses the receipt, while a later legitimate sweep gets a new receipt instead of being suppressed by old Actions history.

This replacement was necessary because the contributor branch allows maintainer edits but the available personal OAuth authorization cannot update workflow files. The final tree preserves and extends @ag-linden's work, with co-author credit in both commits.

## Proof

- Crash/retry runtime smoke: `crash_before_dispatch=wait`, `crash_after_dispatch=recover`, `stale_without_receipt=dispatch`.
- Focused router/workflow/capacity tests: 186 passed.
- Full repository proof: 600 unit tests and 614 repair tests passed; both instrumented coverage modes passed after removing a 10-second test-only scheduler race.
- Changed coverage: 100% lines, 89.17% branches, 100% functions.
- Overall coverage: 76.68% lines, 70.66% branches, 83.99% functions.
- Build, lint, formatting, active-surface, workflow-input, and automation-limit checks passed.
- AutoReview: no accepted or actionable findings; patch correct at 0.82 confidence on the exact final tree.

## Risk

Medium. This changes command-dispatch recovery and three receiving workflows. API-read failures fail closed, claims wait five minutes before stale recovery, failed receipts remain retryable, and receiver-side ownership prevents duplicate execution without losing all copies.

Replaces #380.
